# Why sell on QareGO

**QareGO brings new customers to your counter and delivers your orders for you.** Customers in your area find your store in the QareGO app, order and pay, and a QareGO rider brings the order to their door. You prepare it; we do the rest.

QareGO works for **restaurants and kitchens, grocery shops, pharmacies, gas stations and laundries**.

## What you get

**More customers, without more staff**
- Your store appears in the QareGO app to customers near you, with your photos, prices and opening hours.
- Customers can also order for **pickup** at your counter, or **schedule** an order for later.

**Delivery handled**
- When an order is ready, QareGO finds a nearby rider. You don't hire, pay or manage riders.
- The customer gets a 4-digit code, and the order is only marked delivered when the rider enters the right code. Orders reach the right person.

**You get paid quickly**
- **Cash orders:** the rider pays you your share in cash when they collect the order.
- **Mobile money orders:** your share is sent to your MoMo number automatically when the order is delivered.

**A simple portal**
- Use the **merchant portal** (merchant.qarego.com) on a phone, tablet or computer. New orders ring so you don't miss them.
- Add your menu or price list with photos, set opening hours, mark items sold out, and pause orders when you're busy.
- Give your kitchen staff their own logins, locked to one store.
- See every order and what you earned on the **Transactions** page.

**Low, clear costs**
- **No sign-up fee and no monthly fee.**
- QareGO only earns when you sell: a commission on the **food or item price** of each order. The delivery fee and the customer's service fee are not taken from your price.
- **A free period to start:** new stores can get a period with **no commission at all**, so you can try QareGO without risk. QareGO tells you how long yours is when your store goes live.

## What it costs

| | |
|---|---|
| Joining | Free |
| Monthly fee | None |
| Commission | A percentage of the food or item price of each order, shown in your agreement and on your Transactions page. Default: **15%** (gas stations: **5%** of the gas price). |
| Free period | New stores: **no commission** for the period QareGO gives you when you go live. |
| Delivery | Paid by the customer. Not taken from your price. |

*Example:* a customer orders GH₵100 of food. With 15% commission you get **GH₵85**. During your free period you get the full **GH₵100**.

## How to join

1. Apply on **qarego.com** with "List your store", or WhatsApp us on **050 177 4210**.
2. We send your sign-in details by SMS. Sign in at **merchant.qarego.com** and choose your own password.
3. Set up your store: a photo, your address and map pin, opening hours and at least 3 items with photos. Pharmacies and gas stations also upload their licence.
4. Submit your store. QareGO checks it and lets you know when you are live.

The [vendor guide](vendor-guide.md) explains every step.

**Questions?** WhatsApp **050 177 4210** or email **support@qaretech.com**.
